column1: # scope-map.tsv — read by `scripts/scope-resolve.sh` (`T-06.2`). Format: prefix <TAB> specs <TAB> evidence.
# The prefix is relative to `frontend/`. Specs are two-digit numbers, `NN-MM` ranges and `NN+`
# (NN and every spec numbered above it — a spec added later is included without editing this file).
# Every number must name exactly one `e2e/NN-*.spec.ts`, and every prefix must match a tracked
# file: a rotten map REFUSES (rc=3) instead of silently shrinking the selection.
# HOW A ROW IS USED. The import graph (`scripts/scope-graph.mjs`) comes first and decides the
# route: a file reached by `app/layout.tsx`/`not-found.tsx` is COMPLETE; reached only by the console
# entries it runs `@rota:console`; reached by no page it runs nothing beyond `e2e/11` and the specs
# that import it. The rows below REFINE only files reached exclusively by the `/symbol` route; a
# symbol file without a row runs `@rota:symbol`. A row is a HYPOTHESIS that the other symbol specs
# cannot see the file's effect — the wave's full `make verify` is the backstop, not this file.
# EDITING THIS FILE widens its own diff to COMPLETE: a map already edited cannot judge the change it
# makes (a narrowed row would drop, from that same diff, the spec it breaks — `W8-QA-INFRA.md`, F-1).
# THE EVIDENCE COLUMN IS THE COMMAND. Re-run it before widening or narrowing a row (`-a`:
# `e2e/14` is not UTF-8 and plain `grep` treats it as binary and stays silent).
# route rows (required)
@rota:console
@rota:symbol
